CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulder, forearm and hand.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on ONE wrist, the opening and its two stones on top of the wrist; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A SLIM OPEN CUFF BANGLE: a smooth round polished gold wire about 2mm thick, open at the front, its two ends side by side. One end carries ONE clear SQUARE cushion-cut stone in a four-claw gold box setting; the other end ONE PINK EMERALD-CUT (step-cut) stone, only slightly longer than it is wide and as wide as the clear square, in a four-claw gold box setting. Exactly two stones: one clear square and one pink emerald-cut rectangle; no pave; the wire is plain and smooth, never twisted; ONE cuff only.

SCALE TEST: On the wrist the two stones are SMALL: each about a third of a finger's width and half a fingernail's width, so the cuff, about 6cm across, is about FOURTEEN stone widths across and the two stones together cover only a small part of the top of the wrist; the gap between them about one stone width; the wire a fine line about a third of a stone's width; never chunky, never larger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
